verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover function calling with user-defined tools, typed schemas enforced via strict tool use (`strict: true`) that guarantees schema validation on tool names and inputs, and parallel tool calls by default. The Messages API is positioned for custom agent loops, tool results are returned to the model (as shown in the bash tool docs), and tool use is supported across all current models with typed SDKs and fine-grained tool streaming. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that tool calling is faithful in practice, and explicit documentation of the multi-step tool_use/tool_result loop mechanics (only implied here).
